body:
## Summary
`shadowrunr mcp` is a second, invisible daemon. Its one write (`start_sim`) and its `preflight` run on a private AppState with its own live registry, sandbox registry and (for `live:true` / preflight) its own live engine fleet. Every guard the daemon holds - sandbox-vs-sim exclusion, `max_live_runs`, same-run_id conflict, move_aside of a stale dir - is per-process, so Athena can start a run beside a live sandbox rehearsal, rename the directory of a run the daemon is writing, and spend quota from a fleet the daemon's ledger and cooldowns never see. Runs it starts are also invisible to the console's live view and forward no activity to Personas.

## Description
Add `integrations/mcp_backend.rs`: per write/preflight call, probe the configured daemon port (`engine.status`, ~500 ms). When it answers, `start_sim` and `preflight` are proxied as `/rpc` calls through a `DaemonClient::call_envelope` that keeps the full error envelope (code, message, detail) so MCP `isError` results keep their shape. `live` is checked against the daemon's fleet mode and refused with `engine_mismatch` instead of building a second fleet. When nothing answers, today's in-process path runs unchanged; the result names the host (`daemon` | `mcp`). Read tools stay in-process (they read the same files). Technique: mcp-tools / first-party-agent-is-a-principal ("two doors onto one store resolve their gates separately" -> one admission) and ambient-selection-is-not-an-argument (an operator and an agent acting on one running instance must share its exclusion).

## Flow
- tools/call start_sim -> write gate (unchanged) -> backend probe
- daemon answers -> engine.status mode vs `live` -> mismatch: isError engine_mismatch; else POST /rpc sim.start -> daemon guards apply -> {run_id, host:'daemon'}
- no daemon -> in-process as today -> {host:'mcp'}
- preflight -> daemon preflight.run (PF-09 then carries the daemon forwarder's real counts) or in-process fallback

## Expected impact
One admission door for runs: the sandbox/sim exclusion, run caps and run-dir custody hold for agent-started runs; no second fleet spending quota outside the daemon's ledger; agent-started runs appear live in the console and reach Personas activity.

## Evaluation
Claim: agent writes obey the daemon's guards when a daemon is up
Before: 1 of 7 acceptance cases pass (only the no-daemon fallback)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - acceptance tests written first against server::router(state) served on an ephemeral port
Result: better
Gate: architecture
evidence: mcp_tools.rs:122 `let scripted = AppState::new(cfg.clone(), EngineHandle::scripted());`; :135 `AppState::new((*self.cfg).clone(), (self.factory)(&self.cfg))`; :182 `let state = self.live_state().await;` (preflight); live.rs:319 `if let Some(id) = state.sandbox.running() {`; live.rs:331 `.register(&run_id, state.cfg.daemon.max_live_runs)?;` live.rs:334 `runs::move_aside(&run_dir, ...)`; grep start_for_daemon over crates -> only activity.rs:253 (def) and cli.rs:1564 (daemon serve); mcp.rs:257 `EngineHandle::build(c, false)`.

critic.reason: Strong move; the reverse mismatch direction is the costly one and is untested.

revision: Add a case: daemon up on a live engine; MCP start_sim {} (live defaults false) -> isError engine_mismatch, no run registered in the daemon, EngineFactory called 0 times.

body:
## Summary
Setting up Personas activity today is: configure, start the daemon, run a sim, then read daemon stderr hoping for a 'refused' line. A wrong or rotated secret leaves PF-09 green ('trigger answers'), `personas status` says 'on (secret set)', and every event is silently refused - `rejected` is counted in no figure the operator or console sees. Make the verdict one command and make PF-09 tell the truth.

## Description
(1) `shadowrunr personas status --send-test` signs and POSTs one `{source, kind:'test', ts_ms, project_id?}` body (no show data) to the configured trigger through the same deliver path and classifies the answer: delivered / refused (401/403 = signature or secret mismatch) / trigger_not_found (404) / http_<n> / unreachable, with exit codes 0/1/1/1/3 matching status.rs's existing ladder. Plain `status` never sends; its activity line says 'unverified'. (2) The forwarder records `last_rejected` (status code) beside `rejected`; PF-09 turns Amber with 'N refused (HTTP 401: secret mismatch?)' when rejected > 0, and shows refused next to delivered/dropped. The test kind is never in KNOWN_EVENTS, so configuration cannot route show events to it. Leans on the failure-not-empty-success law as mcp-tools/tool-schema-design states it ('failed calls reading as successes downstream'), applied to the outbound integration; settings stay secret-by-name.

## Flow
- `personas status --send-test` -> settings + secret env -> one signed test POST -> verdict line + exit code
- daemon forwarder refusal -> stats.rejected, stats.last_rejected -> PF-09 Amber 'refused' (the console preflight board shows it with no console change)

## Expected impact
Secret/trigger misconfiguration is found in one command instead of after a show; PF-09 stops reporting green while every event is refused.

## Evaluation
Claim: the operator can verify the signed path and PF-09 reflects refusals
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (no --send-test; PF-09 Green on refusal)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - acceptance tests written first against the existing Fake webhook in activity_tests.rs (personas_verify port)
Result: better
Gate: none (operator-invoked, carries no show data; daemon emission set unchanged)
evidence: forwarder.rs:478-480 `pub fn dropped(&self) -> u64 { self.failed + self.dropped_full + self.dropped_down + self.lagged }`; activity.rs:353 `format!("; {} delivered, {} dropped", s.delivered, s.dropped())`; activity.rs:371-373 `Some(200) => rep(HealthState::Green, ... "trigger answers"`; status.rs:358 `let secret = if std::env::var(a.secret_env.trim()).is_ok_and(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()) { "set" }`; docs/guide/personas.md:65 'the **PF-09** line is green when the trigger answers'.

critic.reason: Extends a cross-repo webhook contract and triggers the external persona; the in-repo remainder is S-sized.
